assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Promotion returns or stores raw annotated strings, the wrong commit, or a truncated commit list instead of full IDs independently read from Git; restoring pre-change raw-string resolution already raises on list and JSON inputs. Expected is Git-derived, not an echo of the supplied annotated strings.
Successful completion leaves the live pointer present.
Promotion silently rewrites the delivered manifest to make it acceptable; delivered is an intentional before/after snapshot of the file, not a functional-output oracle.
The parser splits a subject comma into another entry or loses a list entry; the expected cardinality is independently fixed by the fixture structure.
The positive-control fixture commit does not resolve or the supposedly missing revision actually belongs to the repository; these establish fixture validity, not regression coverage.
Invalid-SHA promotion succeeds or raises a refusal that does not name the SHA and report non-resolution; silently dropping invalid entries would violate the expected refusal.
Refused promotion writes a ledger row or removes the resumable live pointer.

compatibility_evidence.note: Both recorded the same three failure IDs; reviewed only as evidence, with no out-of-node triage.
